content.text:
The internal `store/db/mysql` package (memos' own MySQL `store.Driver` implementation, `mysql.NewDB`) is imported and called only from `store/db/db.go:8,22` — the `NewDBDriver` factory.

h04. no; The only Go file importing `github.com/usememos/memos/store/db/mysql` and calling `mysql.NewDB(...)` is the driver-selection factory itself at `/bench/repo/store/db/db.go:8,22` (`grep -rn "store/db/mysql\"" --include=*.go` returns just that one file). Tests such as `/bench/repo/store/test/store.go:28,50` construct drivers via `db.NewDBDriver(profile)`, which still routes through that same factory (never calling `mysql.NewDB` directly). The other mysql-related import in `/bench/repo/store/test/containers.go` (`mysqldriver "github.com/go-sql-driver/mysql"`) is the raw third-party SQL driver used only for DSN parsing/connectivity checks in test container setup — not memos' `store.Driver` implementation. No other file constructs the memos MySQL driver directly.
